description: This file defines the EmployeeDeletedEvent class, which extends the Event class, within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It encapsulates an event that occurs when an employee is deleted, storing related employee numbers.

classes.name: EmployeeDeletedEvent
classes.description: Represents an event triggered when an employee is deleted, encapsulating the employee numbers involved.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers associated with the deletion event.
